expansion_clauses.label: BB1 rooted chart and K/H split
expansion_clauses.statement: On the good sector, the rooted common-stem holonomy-log variables and positive-high coordinates must give a controlled local chart modulo gauge.
expansion_clauses.finite_or_formal_evidence: C5AL gives the tangent high/gauge split; C5AZ gives finite rooted gauge and reflection covariance.
expansion_clauses.good_sector_status: finite tangent pass; nonlinear compact uniformity open
expansion_clauses.required_next_lemma: uniform inverse-function/disintegration lemma in rooted coordinates
expansion_clauses.failure_trigger: chart derivative loses invertibility or constants grow with the UV cutoff/good-sector radius

expansion_clauses.label: BB2 conditional RN expansion
expansion_clauses.statement: The conditional high measure at fixed shifted K must have an RN expansion g X1 + g^2 X2 + R_ge3 with a summable good-sector remainder.
expansion_clauses.finite_or_formal_evidence: C5AJ fixes the cumulant algebra; C5T-C5X provide finite BCH/action inputs.
expansion_clauses.good_sector_status: formal coefficient algebra pass; exact compact shell expansion open
expansion_clauses.required_next_lemma: analytic RN expansion through O(g^2) with explicit shifted coordinate/density terms
expansion_clauses.failure_trigger: nonanalytic compact effects or uncontrolled Jacobian terms enter at O(g) or O(g^2)

expansion_clauses.label: BB3 O(g) placement
expansion_clauses.statement: The O(g) retained cubic must be exact retained coordinate/action data, and high-mode O(g) tadpoles must be centered.
expansion_clauses.finite_or_formal_evidence: C5AD places retained S1; C5W centers the high-mode cubic in the Gaussian reference.
expansion_clauses.good_sector_status: finite/formal pass; exact shifted conditional centering open
expansion_clauses.required_next_lemma: prove no shifted conditional O(g) tadpole survives outside retained data
expansion_clauses.failure_trigger: an unretained O(g_j M_j^p) mean appears in the exact conditional shell

expansion_clauses.label: BB4 O(g^2) slot matching
expansion_clauses.statement: Every O(g^2) local output must match V_RP, V_comp, or J_shifted^{1/2}; none may remain residual.
expansion_clauses.finite_or_formal_evidence: C5AI/C5BA show no known unmatched finite-block O(g^2) survivor.
expansion_clauses.good_sector_status: ledger pass; exact coefficient theorem open
expansion_clauses.required_next_lemma: compute exact shifted O(g^2) coefficient map and compare to normalized slots
expansion_clauses.failure_trigger: any nonlocal, gauge-variant, OS-incompatible, or unmatched O(g^2) output remains

expansion_clauses.label: BB5 centered odd density
expansion_clauses.statement: The shifted odd K/H density channel must have zero conditional mean so its first effect is a second cumulant.
expansion_clauses.finite_or_formal_evidence: C5AV gives degree/oddness; C5AZ restores reflection placement; C5BA supplies shifted constant.
expansion_clauses.good_sector_status: reference Gaussian centering pass; exact conditional centering open
expansion_clauses.required_next_lemma: prove the shifted bilinear odd channel has zero mean under the exact conditional reference
expansion_clauses.failure_trigger: a nonzero O(g_j^2 M_j^2) density drift appears from the odd channel

expansion_clauses.label: BB6 rooted covariance envelope
expansion_clauses.statement: The centered odd channel must satisfy an L2 envelope controlled by C_cov,shifted^2, or a replacement constant with the same summability class.
expansion_clauses.finite_or_formal_evidence: Corrected C5AZ/C5BA give C_cov,rooted^2=0.214804676794, and the O(g_j^4 M_j^4) budget is summable.
expansion_clauses.good_sector_status: finite-block bound pass; uniform good-sector and quasilocality open
expansion_clauses.required_next_lemma: prove a deterministic shifted L2 bound stable under the exact shell disintegration
expansion_clauses.failure_trigger: the covariance constant is nonlocal, cutoff-growing, or couples to exceptional near-Cartan valleys

expansion_clauses.label: BB7 exceptional sector
expansion_clauses.statement: Chart failures, large fields, and near-Cartan coherent valleys must have summable cost or be retained.
expansion_clauses.finite_or_formal_evidence: C5M gives a schedule; C5N gives a finite normal-form tail only in a restricted model.
expansion_clauses.required_next_lemma: prove local Wilson-action/FP/chart exceptional estimates for the shifted coordinate package
expansion_clauses.failure_trigger: exceptional probability or comparison-form defect is not summable over shells
